connectivity_inference.statement: If each original surface is verified as a closed connected embedded oriented 2-manifold, it bounds a solid region; an exact point strictly inside both shows positive interior intersection, so the two regions' union is connected.
connectivity_inference.topology_reference: Hatcher, Algebraic Topology, Section 3.3, Alexander duality Corollary 3.45: https://pi.math.cornell.edu/~hatcher/AT/ATch3.pdf
